{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater: slim crew neck, hip length, long sleeves, dusty blue-grey #6f8296, merino wool
A-line midi skirt: falls below the knee, softly flared, deep burgundy #6e2f3f, wool crepe
Single-breasted coat: straight cut, knee length, notch collar, camel #b58b5e, wool blend
Opaque tights: matte, dark charcoal #2b2a2e, nylon
Ankle boots: round toe, low block heel, dark brown #3a2a26, smooth leather
Scarf: light and wide, worn loosely around the neck, cream #e6dccd, wool-silk blend
Structured shoulder bag: medium size, dark brown #3a2a26, leather
Stud earrings: small and round, warm gold #c9a24a, metal

This outfit is neat and modest for a church service, with covered shoulders and a skirt below the knee, and it stays comfortable through a long lunch with your parents afterwards. The dusty blue-grey of the sweater echoes your eye color and sits softly against your light skin, while the burgundy skirt adds depth next to your dark hair. The camel coat and cream scarf keep the autumn palette warm and calm, and the dark tights and brown boots tie everything together. The low block heel makes standing and sitting through the service easy without losing polish."}
